data.reason: Adding a conditional attribute to generated code could affect runtime behavior differently across target frameworks, and the conditional logic must precisely match what code is actually generated to avoid silent inconsistencies between coverage reports and actual code presence.

prompt_preview:
<requirement>
Add ExcludeFromCodeCoverage attribute to generated code.

#### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
MessagePack generated code is not decorated with ExcludeFromCodeCoverage attribute.

Because it is very hard to write good coverage for generated MessagePack code, it may skew coverage numbers, especially on large projects with a lot of generated code.
